name: Dominion Lending Centres Inc.
summary: Dominion Lending Centres Inc. provides mortgage brokerage franchising and mortgage broker data connectivity services in Canada. The company provides end-to-end services to automate the mortgage application, approval, underwriting, and funding process; and additional services providing management of daily operations and data resources access. It offers its software and services through various lender and broker facing products under Velocity, Link, LinkLender, and Connect brand names, as well as Dominion Lending Centres, Mortgage Architects, and The Mortgage Centre brands.
